name: Joinery AI
description: Scheduled LLM recipes that gather information, write to a workspace, and deliver results to a dashboard or email.
author: Joinery

settings.name: joinery_ai_selection_policy
settings.label: How a model is chosen

options.prefer_local: Prefer my own hardware, then the cheapest that qualifies (recommended)
options.cheapest: Cheapest that qualifies, wherever it runs
options.best: Most capable that qualifies, then cheapest

settings.helptext: Recipes say what they need, not which model to use, and this decides among the models that qualify. Preferring your own hardware is the platform's standing posture: reaching a vendor is then always a consequence of a floor your hardware could not meet.

settings.name: joinery_ai_anthropic_api_key
settings.label: Anthropic API Key
settings.helptext: Required when the provider is Anthropic. Get one from console.anthropic.com.

settings.name: joinery_ai_local_base_url
settings.label: Local Base URL
settings.helptext: OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM, LM Studio). Use the host URL if the server is not on this box.

settings.name: joinery_ai_local_model
settings.label: Local Model
settings.helptext: Model id(s) your host serves, comma-separated, exactly as it names them.

settings.name: joinery_ai_local_api_key
settings.label: Local API Key
settings.helptext: Only for servers that require a key; Ollama ignores it.

settings.name: joinery_ai_local_timeout_seconds
settings.label: Local Timeout (s)
settings.helptext: Per-call HTTP timeout — the max quiet gap between tokens once the model is generating. CPU-only local generation is slow, so keep this high.

settings.name: joinery_ai_local_first_token_timeout_seconds
settings.label: Local First-Token Timeout (s)
settings.helptext: How long to wait for the model to start responding before failing the turn. Bounds a cold model load or an overloaded host so a stalled request fails fast.

settings.name: joinery_ai_fireworks_api_key
settings.label: Fireworks API Key
settings.helptext: Required to use Fireworks models. Get one from fireworks.ai. Fireworks does not train on open-model traffic.

settings.name: joinery_ai_fireworks_base_url
settings.label: Fireworks Base URL
settings.helptext: OpenAI-compatible Fireworks endpoint. The default is correct for the public API.

settings.name: joinery_ai_brave_search_api_key
settings.label: Brave Search API Key
settings.helptext: Required only for recipes that use the web_search tool. Free tier (2,000 queries/month) at api.search.brave.com.

settings.name: joinery_ai_market_data_provider
settings.label: Market data provider
settings.helptext: Which market-data service get_stock_data calls. Currently finnhub.

settings.name: joinery_ai_market_data_api_key
settings.label: Market Data API Key (Finnhub)
settings.helptext: Required only for recipes that use get_stock_data. Free tier at finnhub.io.

settings.name: joinery_ai_default_model
settings.label: Default model for new chats
settings.helptext: Which model a new conversation starts on, as your host or vendor names it. Chat is a pick-your-own surface, so this is taste rather than a requirement. Blank, or a model this install cannot reach, starts the chat on whatever is available. Recipes never read this - they state what they need instead.

settings.name: joinery_ai_failure_email_throttle_seconds
settings.label: Failure Email Throttle (s)
settings.helptext: Minimum seconds between failure-notification emails per recipe.

settings.name: joinery_ai_workspace_max_chars
settings.label: Workspace Size Cap (chars)
settings.helptext: Hard cap on the per-recipe workspace blob; set_workspace rejects oversize writes.

settings.name: joinery_ai_max_concurrent_workers
settings.label: Max Concurrent Workers
settings.helptext: Limits how many recipe runs can be in flight simultaneously.

settings.name: joinery_ai_global_monthly_token_cap
settings.label: Global Monthly Token Cap
settings.helptext: Hard ceiling across all recipes per calendar month.

settings.name: joinery_ai_chat_enabled
settings.label: Chat enabled
settings.helptext: Turns the AI chat surface on or off for everyone.

settings.name: joinery_ai_chat_max_iterations
settings.label: Max tool iterations per turn
settings.helptext: How many times the assistant may call a tool and think again before it must answer.

settings.name: joinery_ai_chat_system_prompt
settings.label: Chat System Prompt
settings.helptext: Sets the chat assistant's voice. Leave blank to use the default. The date/time, tool rules and safety instructions are always added automatically and cannot be removed here.

settings.name: joinery_ai_default_chat_level
settings.label: Default privacy for new chats

options.standard: Standard — the server manages the chat for you
options.private: Private — only you can read the stored chat (unlock required)
options.fortress: Fortress — chat content never leaves your hardware (local model only)

settings.helptext: Applied to every new chat; each chat can override it. Private and Fortress seal the stored chat under your vault, so they need a set-up vault to unlock — a chat falls back to Standard when you have none. Fortress additionally pins a local model, so nothing is sent to a cloud AI provider.

settings.name: joinery_ai_default_temperature
settings.label: Default temperature
settings.helptext: 0 is deterministic, higher is more varied. Each chat can override.

settings.name: joinery_ai_default_top_p
settings.label: Default top-p
settings.helptext: Leave blank to let the provider decide.

settings.name: joinery_ai_memory_default_on
settings.label: Memory on by default for new chats
settings.helptext: New chats start with the Memory capability enabled; each chat can toggle it off. Memories are managed under Joinery AI → Memory.

settings.name: joinery_ai_memory_prefetch_max
settings.label: Memory pre-retrieval cap (count)
settings.helptext: Most memory bodies auto-opened per turn when their words match the message.

settings.name: joinery_ai_memory_prefetch_max_chars
settings.label: Memory pre-retrieval cap (chars)
settings.helptext: Total character budget for those auto-opened bodies; overflow is truncated with a marker the assistant can follow up on with recall.

settings.name: joinery_ai_memory_context_max_entries
settings.label: Memory index cap (entries)
settings.helptext: Most personal memories listed (titles only) in each turn's memory index. Shared memories are always listed and do not count against this.

settings.name: joinery_ai_attach_document_max_bytes
settings.label: Max document attachment (bytes)
settings.helptext: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, EPUB, RTF, forwarded mail and calendar files. These are read as text before they reach a model.

settings.name: joinery_ai_chat_default_tools
settings.label: Default chat tools
settings.helptext: Comma-separated tool names offered to a new chat when the user has not chosen their own. Empty means every tool the chat level allows.
